title.narrative: Fortalecimiento organizativo de FICCI y desarrollo de la cadenas

description.narrative: The Integral Federation of Marketing of Cooperatives of Ixcán (FICCI R.L.) is a second-level organization that brings together 3 agricultural cooperatives in the municipality of Ixcán, Quiché. Its mission is to promote cooperativism and social, economic and environmental development through agroecological production, value addition and solidarity marketing, for the benefit of women, young people and associated men. The project presented for the period 2025-2028 seeks to strengthen FICCI and its cooperatives through the development of organizational, economic, social and environmental capacities, in order to move towards institutional self-sustainability and guarantee the full exercise of the economic, social and cultural rights of its bases. The initiative will directly benefit 345 people and indirectly more than 1,700 members of the participating cooperatives. The project focuses on consolidating FICCI's technical, organizational and commercial capacities through technical assistance services and strategies that promote sustainable production systems, access to differentiated markets, climate resilience and active participation of women and youth. Their actions will also strengthen commercial management in value chains such as cocoa and promote women's economic empowerment through productive initiatives and co-responsibility in care.
